senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) hostile being, hinderer, disturber; accuser, Satan.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 218:5">Sifré Deut. 218</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:10">Deut. XXI, 10</cite> sq., a. 18 sq.) <he>אביו של זה … והכניס ש׳ לתוך ביתו וכ׳</he> this man’s father loved a fair captive, and brought the disturber into his house, and his son became rebellious. Y. Sabb. V, 5ᵇ top, v. <cite ref="S00830"><he>קִטְיֵג</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 19a">Ber. 19ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אל יפתח אדם פיו לש׳</he> man must not open his mouth for Satan, i.e. invite misfortune by ominous words.
<cite ref="Shabbat 89a:3">Sabb. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>בשעה שירד … בא ש׳ וכ׳</he> when Moses had gone down from the presence of the Lord, Satan came, and said &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 89a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>בא ש׳ ועירבב וכ׳</he> Satan came (to the Israelites), and brought confusion into the world.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16b:2">R. Hash. 16ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01260"><he>עִרְבֵּב</he></cite>. Yalk. Dan. 1063 <he>ביום … נולד שְׂטָנוֹ דריוש</he> on the day that Nebuchadnezzar entered the Temple … his adversary Darius was born. Tanḥ. Vayishl. 8 <he>מפני שהש׳ מזדווג לו</he> because Satan joins him (the wicked on his road); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 843:1">Yalk. Ps. 843</cite> <he>מפני שמלאכי ש׳ מלוין אותו</he> because Satan’s messengers escort him; a. fr.—<he>בכור ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00769"><he>בְּכוֹר</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>שְׂטָנִים</he>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11">Deut. R. s. 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01055"><he>סַמָּאֵל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:10">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>שלשה ש׳ נזדווגו לו</he> three hindrances befell him (Solomon, <cite ref="I Kings 11:14">I Kings XI, 14</cite>; <cite ref="I Kings 11:23">23</cite>; <cite ref="I Kings 11:25">25</cite>); a. e.
